explanation: The statement is about the library's own definitions `List.box` (= `List.multibox 1`, i.e. taking the image of `l.toFinset` under the modal `Box` operator and converting back to a list), built on the local typeclasses `Box`/`Dia`. Mathlib has no modal-logic `Box`/`Dia` typeclasses (grep for `class Box` / `class Dia` and for `multibox` gives nothing relevant; the only `box` declarations found are graph box products, interval boxes, BoxIntegral boxes, etc.). So there is no Mathlib declaration stating `□'([]) = []` for this notion; the result is a trivial consequence of the library's own definitions (unfolding to `Finset.toList ∅ = []`), not of any Mathlib theorem.
